topic: Can satellite orbital configurations optimize ML-based QoS by reducing propagation delays for latency-sensitive traffic classes?
consensus_response: Satellite orbital configurations can optimize ML-based QoS by utilizing LEO satellites, dynamic traffic routing, beamforming, MIMO, and adaptive modulation. ML algorithms predict optimal configurations, minimizing latency and interference. This integrated approach enhances capacity, reliability, and QoS for latency-sensitive traffic.
reference_context: QoS mechanisms like DiffServ neglect high fixed latencies in satellite links, impacting QoS in converged networks.
